content.comment_body: I want to place an [product_name] at a distance of 10 meters from the electrical cabinet where my [product_name] is located, but I only found a 2.5m cable. Is there anywhere I could get a longer cable?

I'm not certain longer cables are officially available. What we did is cut the standard cable and extended it using extra connectors and regular wiring. Looking at the 9-pin connector, these wires are used: 1: VPS (bk) 3: RS485A (rd) 5: M (bn) 8: RS485B (or) Since RS485 is the protocol, using an unshielded cable up to 10 meters should be fine. For better performance, use twisted pair cables for the RS485 signals, and if shielded, they can work at lengths up to several hundred meters reliably. Alternatively, you can buy a standard SubD 9-pin extension cable. Good luck

You can use an RS232 cable with a 1:1 connection with all pins present. Place this cable between the [product_name] and the [product_name] Cable. For total lengths of up to 10 meters, [company_name] guarantees operation. Hope this is helpful.
